verdict.rationale: ClickHouse describes itself in its own llms.txt as an open-source DBMS. Its code is hosted in the public GitHub repository ClickHouse/ClickHouse, and it publishes OSS changelogs, so users can read the source under an open-source model. missing for 10: explicit naming of the license (e.g., the license file or terms), and independent corroboration of source accessibility and licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: ClickHouse is a fast open-source column-oriented database management system (DBMS)
